title: Run a design-time operation using an already-current build
goal: Reuse a freshly built EF design-time consumer in Visual Studio PMC while avoiding stale migration artifacts.

selectionNotes: Reuse a freshly built EF design-time consumer in Visual Studio PMC while avoiding stale migration artifacts.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF11 consumer requires net11.0; no EF11-on-net10 route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Exact current-release proof uses SDK11 RC3, not GA.

frameworks: Standalone Microsoft.NET.Sdk console; no web framework requirement
packageAssets: EF11 lib/net11.0; EF10 lib/net10.0. Exact SQLite native and transitive assets in canonical locks; Tools supplies PMC commands, Design is explicitly referenced.
providers: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite; disposable in-memory runtime checks and local design-time connection strings, no external resources.
platforms: Visual Studio on Windows with actual NuGet Package Manager Console; compiled consumer on Windows x64.
renderingModes: Not applicable: console/database consumer; no renderer or browser
constraints: Historical .NET10 comparison adds no target10 edition or foundation.
No migrations is distinct from no pending migrations. Resolve wrong assembly/project selection before choosing schema ownership.
Only Add-Migration and Update-Database are claimed here. NoBuild requires a current matching configuration, framework, startup and target assembly.
Save, restore and build after model/package changes and after scaffolding before Update-Database.
prerequisites: Exact SDK10.0.403 and SDK11 11.0.100 with matching locked EF packages.
Visual Studio with NuGet PMC and matching Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools package loaded.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API guidance prepared with exact RC2 packages; GA reconciliation remains pending.
Actual PMC execution pending H_PMC_PROOF; publication with this gap explicitly approved by Pingu.

evidence.scope: Canonical compilation, real sync/async empty-migration behavior and external-owner SQLite read; no PMC or GA proof.
Canonical compilation, real sync/async empty-migration behavior and external-owner SQLite read; no PMC or GA proof.

Pingu performed real Visual Studio 18.11.0 PMC Add-Migration/Update-Database NoBuild on 5 November 2026; host 7.11.0.24, PowerShell 5.1.26100.9711, SDK11 RC3 and EF11 RC2. Generated migrations, unchanged stale DLL, rebuilt AddColumn and actual SQLite schema/history verified. Exact mixed baseline only; no EF RC3 or GA claim.
